lead.hed: USNI: Hung Cao needs House and Senate waivers to be confirmed as SECNAV
lead.insight: USNI News, Monday: Acting Secretary of the Navy Hung Cao needs a congressional waiver from both chambers to be eligible for confirmation as the permanent Navy secretary. Service-secretary law requires a cooling-off period after leaving active duty; Cao’s clock still needs those two votes.
lead.image_credit: U.S. Navy photo · DVIDS 9872029 · Public domain · An F-35C launches from USS Abraham Lincoln (CVN-72).

political.hed: USNI: Navy trials a robotic towed connector to refuel a USV
political.insight: USNI News, Monday: the Navy trialled a robotic towed connector last month to capture, refuel, and release an unmanned surface vessel, aiming at longer unmanned time at sea. The write-up cites an August 11 trial and a Tuesday command release.

political.hed: USNI posts the CRS fighter-force structure report for Congress
political.insight: USNI News, Monday: the desk posted the Sept. 4 Congressional Research Service report on Air Force fighter force structure — inventory mix, missions, and issues for Congress. It is a document drop, not a new buy decision.

political.hed: Defense News: Ukraine asked the EU to fund its first PAC-3 Patriot buy
political.insight: Defense News, Saturday: Kyiv asked to tap a €90 billion EU support loan for PAC-3 interceptors. Because the missiles are U.S.-built, the purchase needs an exemption from the loan’s non-EU content cap. The Commission said the review was moving into this week.

tech.hed: Heritage: China is working the U.S. fight over AI data centers
tech.insight: Heritage Foundation, Thursday: the essay says CCP-linked actors have amplified U.S. local fights over AI data centers, treating power prices and siting fights as a way to slow American compute. It is commentary, not a new statute.

tech.hed: NVIDIA at IFA: local agents, PAIR routing, RTX Spark in October
tech.insight: NVIDIA vendor post from IFA: local agents get simpler setup on RTX hardware, RTX Spark Windows PCs arrive in October, and NVIDIA PAIR can route inference across idle PCs.

culture.hed: Law & Liberty: a liberal education worthy of the name
culture.insight: Law & Liberty, Monday: Daniel J. Mahoney reviews Harvey Mansfield’s long fight for academic rigor at Harvard. The piece is a book essay, not a campus incident report.

culture.hed: Law & Liberty: the argument we forgot how to have
culture.insight: Law & Liberty, Monday: American free-expression doctrine is younger than most people think. The piece traces an older legal tradition that handled speech problems the modern First Amendment still debates.
